names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 30 noiembrie, «Sfântul Ierarh Frumențiu, Episcopul Etiopiei», with the rank word and the see left off.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 30 Νοεμβρίου, «Άγιος Φρουμέντιος αρχιεπίσκοπος Αβησσυνίας», with the rank word and the see left off.

The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 2339, «Святитель Фрументий Индийский (Эфиопский), архиепископ», with the rank and the trailing grade left off. The calendar gives him two countries, India first and Ethiopia in brackets after it, and the day line keeps both: «Свт. Фрументия , архиеп. Индийского (Ефиопского)».

feast.note: His name page 2339 gives «День памяти: 30 ноября» and no other day.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 30 ноября ст. ст. — «Свт. Фрументия , архиеп. Индийского (Ефиопского) (ок. 380).»
Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 30 noiembrie — «Sfântul Ierarh Frumențiu, Episcopul Etiopiei»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 30ής Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιος Φρουμέντιος αρχιεπίσκοπος Αβησσυνίας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 30 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the page, and it is the same man, the apostle of Ethiopia whom the Romanian line gave a rank and a see and nothing else. It answers the three things that folder said were not said: how he came to Ethiopia, who consecrated him, and when. It prints no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (25 September 2026).

floruit.note: saint.gr: «Στα χρόνια του μεγάλου Κωνσταντίνου (330 μ.Χ.)», and the consecration that page describes falls inside the episcopate it names; the interval is the one that folder was first written with and is kept.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru closes his line with «ок. 380», about 380, where it would otherwise print a year. Neither doxologia.ro nor saint.gr gave him a year of death at all, so this is the folder's first, and the display keeps the calendar's own «ок.»
